title: Port the dashboard and job-start changes made since the last sync

notes:
Ports the commits made in the main working copy after the sync tag `triglav-sync-2026-10-12` (up to `edcd752`), one target commit per source commit, with the original messages.

| Source | Target | Subject |
|---|---|---|
| 409f514 | skipped | Limit research and triage runs to read-only built-in tools |
| 9b85de3 | a8bebe0 | Let the Client cancel a job request the runner has not started |
| d951f90 | fa609d9 | Make agent text easier to read in the dashboard |
| 8de4d56 | f52e9d0 | Lay decision cards out in two columns instead of a narrow one |
| b405a89 | e33236c | Let the Client start a new Staff for a job whose owner is unavailable |
| ae7bfee | 42effb6 | Expand a leading ~ in the repository path of a new job |
| 1eb984f | b4aad37 | Show the start of a job as steps, and let the Client approve with a last answer |
| bd273f5 | fad42e6 | Disable Start new Staff and show a spinner while Staff starts |
| 003c742 | 676ad1c | Collapse client decisions to their first line, expandable on click |
| 74a3627 | 02dd161 | Require only title and question on the Client's timed question form |
| edcd752 | 78bd12e | Move Board from the More menu to the main navigation |

## Skipped

409f514 is covered by the public release (#5). Its research part (`--tools Read,Grep,Glob`) is already in `scripts/research-run.ts` (`claudeResearchArgs`), together with `--strict-mcp-config` and the private MCP config. Its triage part changes `triageRun` in `scripts/runner.ts`, which does not exist in this repository. Nothing was taken from it, and `scripts/runner.ts` is unchanged by this PR.

## Adjustments made while porting

Applied with `git am -3`. Conflicts were resolved by hand and a few fixes were folded into the commit they belong to, so each target commit builds and passes on its own terms:

- Author reset to the repository identity on all commits (the source author used a work email).
- d951f90: the source hard-coded two ticket prefixes and a Linear workspace URL. This keeps the generic ticket pattern and the `TicketLink` component already in `main`, and adds only the monospace rendering of CLI flags, env names and file references.
- 9b85de3: the e2e test reads `/api/job-requests` with `clientFetch` (the route needs a session here). The new `cancel` route is added to the 401 table in `test/client-auth.test.ts`. It is not in `OPEN_API_ROUTES`, so it needs the Client session.
- b405a89: the new `POST /api/jobs/:id/new-staff` route is added to the same 401 table, and is also not in `OPEN_API_ROUTES`.
- ae7bfee, 1eb984f: kept the e2e compose limits and the review mode picker from `main` next to the source changes. Test paths use a fake home.
- 003c742: the e2e test for ticket links in a decision now opens the collapsed card first.
- 74a3627: `test/coordination.test.ts` still expected `summary is required` from `askQuestion`. That check is now only for the Client form (the agent tool keeps its schema), so the test checks `title is required` instead. The source commit left that test failing.
- edcd752: no Triage entry in the More menu here, so the e2e menu check is `Usage, Models, Guide`.

Kept as is: password min 8 / max 1000 (`src/client-auth.ts`), chat token hashing, `staffStartEnv`, and the deny-by-default `OPEN_API_ROUTES`. No migration in this range, and `026_chat_token_hash.sql` is untouched.

## Open PRs 3 and 4

Both look superseded by this port, and are left open for the maintainer to close:

- #3 (cancel-queued-request) is the same change as a8bebe0, plus the 401 table entry that is also in this PR.
- #4 (approve-sends-answer) overlaps b4aad37, which has the approve with a last answer as part of the larger steps-of-a-job change.

## Deploy

- `docker compose up -d --build` (restarts the server). `ORCH_HOST_HOME` is new in `docker-compose.yml` and is set from `${HOME}`, so a `~/` repository path works.
- No runner restart: `scripts/runner.ts` is not changed.
- No migration.
